rationale: Jawad is building Collaborative Intelligence, an AI-focused company, and brings deep fintech and LLM tooling domain expertise from his founding and executive background. Kobe is a software engineer at LMCache working on LLM infrastructure, with strong Python and systems-level skills that could directly support the technical development of AI applications. They're positioned to explore how Jawad's founder perspective and domain knowledge could intersect with Kobe's infrastructure expertise.
intro_message: Jawad Koradia, meet Kobe — you're both operating in the LLM space from different angles (founder/AI product vs. LLM infrastructure engineer) and could have interesting conversations about what technical foundations matter most for AI startups.
